items.question: Which body is responsible for regulating and operating the .ae country code domain namespace in the UAE?
items.gold: Domain Administration (.aeDA) of the Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority.
items.fact: .aeDA regulates and operates the .ae domain namespace.

items.question: Who is the accredited registrar for the .abudhabi domain name?
items.gold: Etisalat is the accredited registrar of the .abudhabi domain.
items.fact: Etisalat is the accredited registrar for .abudhabi domains.
